# KASPI POS (كسب) — Full Context Specification for AI Search & LLM Engines

## 1. Overview & Positioning
KASPI POS (`pos-saas-morocco`) is an enterprise-grade Point of Sale (POS) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform developed specifically for Moroccan retailers, food & beverage merchants, grocery stores, pharmacies, and service businesses. It solves the critical reliability bottleneck of Moroccan retail infrastructure by operating 100% offline-first while maintaining instant cryptographic cloud synchronization when connectivity is available.

## 2. Business Model & Transparent Pricing Rule
- First Active Terminal (Poste Principal): 200 MAD per month. Provides 100% full ERP feature suite, multi-store capabilities, inventory alerts, kitchen display system (KDS), AI insights, and automated daily offsite encrypted backups.
- Additional Terminals (Poste Additionnel): 150 MAD per month per extra connected register in the same tenant account.
- Zero Setup Fees, Zero Hidden Commissions, Zero Hardware Lock-in.

## 3. Regulatory & Banking Framework
- Bank Al-Maghrib Law 103-12: KASPI POS operates strictly as a Non-Custodial Technical Service Provider (TSP). It does not hold merchant funds; all payments settle directly with the merchant's acquiring bank.
- DGI Compliance: Article 145 of the Moroccan General Tax Code (Code Général des Impôts). Enforces immutable invoice sequence numbering (`INV-YYYY-MM-XXXXXX`), accurate TVA calculations (7%, 10%, 14%, 20%), and zero tax-ID tampering.
- CNDP Law 09-08: Full compliance with Moroccan personal data protection mandates.
- PCI-DSS v4.0.1: Scoped to SAQ A-EP. PAN, CVV, and PIN data are never captured, logged, or stored on client devices or application databases.

## 4. Architectural Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS with visionOS frosted glass aesthetics (`pearl-light` and `fjord-twilight` themes).
- Desktop Runtime: Tauri v2 with Rust backend, providing zero-overhead local ESC/POS thermal printing, COM/Serial/USB device bridges, and secure hardware fingerprinting.
- Database & ORM: PostgreSQL with Neon Serverless Postgres, Prisma ORM with strict tenant and store isolation.
- Offline Storage & Cryptography: IndexedDB / Dexie.js with WebCrypto ECDSA P-256 non-extractable cryptographic key generation, chaining queued sales via `prevHash -> sha256(canonicalPayload) -> ECDSA signature`.
- Payment & TPE Integration: Universal 7-Protocol Hub supporting Nexo (ISO 20022), OPI, CMI Morocco, Ingenico, Verifone, PAX, and Castles terminals.

## 5. Security & Anti-Abuse Controls
- Strict 1-Poste Hardware Binding: Physical OS machine hash (Tauri) and WebCrypto P-256 fingerprint bound to database slot #1.
- Dual-Device Conflict Lockdown: Instant freeze if an unauthorized secondary PC attempts to operate on a 1-poste license quota, with customer-first clean shutdown reboot grace recovery.
- Defense-in-Depth Shield: Prototype pollution sanitizer (CWE-1321), CSRF same-origin validation (CWE-352), binary magic-byte upload verification (CWE-434), SSRF shield (CWE-918), timing-safe HMAC webhook verification (CWE-208/294), and opaque production error masking (CWE-209).
- Automated Zero-Cost Security Bots: Gitleaks, TruffleHog, GitHub CodeQL SAST, Dependabot, and proprietary secret scanning.
